summary.text: George 'Chip' Tangen, the Libertarian candidate and a relationship manager at Enterprise Minnesota, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of Minnesota to Steve Simon.
With political science and law degrees, he is a former legislative counsel to U.S. Rep. Jim Ramstad and campaigned on easier ballot access for candidates and minor parties.

paragraphs.text: Tangen lives in Inver Grove Heights and works as a relationship manager at Enterprise Minnesota.
He holds a political science degree from Middlebury College and a law degree from the University of Minnesota Law School.
Tangen served as legislative counsel to U.S. Rep. Jim Ramstad.
He has been active in the Libertarian Party for a decade.
He received 2.0% of the vote to Steve Simon's 54.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
